unsupported.errors.unmatched: Express's final handler answers a path no route matches, and before it writes, on-finished listens on the request's socket. @codegenie/serverless-express gives the request a socket stub with no on method, so the final handler throws and the adapter answers 500. This is CodeGenieApp/serverless-express#698.
unsupported.errors.wrong_method: Express's final handler answers a method the path has no route for, and before it writes, on-finished listens on the request's socket. @codegenie/serverless-express gives the request a socket stub with no on method, so the final handler throws and the adapter answers 500. This is CodeGenieApp/serverless-express#698.
